items.html: Also understand that in the two first Eheyehs, each one has twenty-seven letters of the filling of the filling, and they are the secret of the twenty-seven letters of the Torah, as is known, for the letters are from Bina. But in the last Eheyeh there are only twenty-five letters of the filling of the filling, from which is all the formation of ZA in the aspect of the blood, and afterwards in the aspect of the milk that he sucks. And this is what is said in the portion of Shemot: "And He said: Thus shall you say to the children of Israel: Eheyeh has sent me to you" — it is the third Eheyeh in the verse, which has twenty-five letters, and therefore it says "Thus shall you say." And it has already been explained above that these verses speak of the matter of the formation of ZA.
